name: SVC_WO_SCHEDULERS_B
description: This table is used to store the scheduler configuration.

columns.name: SCHEDULER_ID
columns.description: An autogenerated number and primary key for the SVC_WO_SCHEDULERS_B table.

columns.name: CONNECTION_CD
columns.description: The foreign key referencing the CONNECTION_CD in the SVC_WO_CONNECTIONS table.

columns.name: ACTIVE_FLAG
columns.description: Property used to identify if a specific scheduler is active.

columns.name: SCHEDULER_TYPE_CD
columns.description: Property used to identify the scheduling type for a specific scheduler.

columns.name: SCHEDULER_CD
columns.description: For identifying the scheduler record uniquely during import/export.

columns.name: SCHEDULER_ORDER
columns.description: The order in which a scheduler configuration should be applied.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CALENDAR_VIEW_SOURCE_CD
columns.description: Property used to identify the source of the calendar view.

columns.name: RESOURCE_TYPE_CD
columns.description: Property used to identify the type of the resource to be listed in scheduler.

columns.name: SHOW_RESOURCE_NAME_FLAG
columns.description: Property used to indicate whether the scheduler will show the resource name in the week view.

columns.name: ALLOW_ASSIGN_BUCKET_FLAG
columns.description: Property used to indicate whether the scheduler will allow buckets to be used for assignment.

columns.name: CALENDAR_VIEW_DEFAULT_CD
columns.description: Property used to identify the default calendar view, either month or week.

columns.name: ALLOW_MONTH_FLAG
columns.description: Property used to indicate whether the scheduler can be shown in month view.

columns.name: ENFORCE_PREFERRED_TECH_FLAG
columns.description: Property used to indicate whether the preferred technician tags should be enforced on the scheduler.

columns.name: ALLOW_OVERRIDE_FLAG
columns.description: Property used to indicate whether the scheduler will allow the selection of booked time slots.

columns.name: WEEK_START_DAY_CD
columns.description: Property used to indicate the start day of the week for the scheduler.

columns.name: AVAILABLE_SLOT_COLOR
columns.description: Property used to indicate the background color to be used for available time slots.

columns.name: BOOKED_SLOT_COLOR
columns.description: Property used to indicate the background color to be used for booked time slots.

columns.name: UNAVAILABLE_SLOT_COLOR
columns.description: Property used to indicate the background color to be used for unavailable time slots.

columns.name: WITHIN_SLA_SLOT_COLOR
columns.description: Property used to indicate the background color to be used for within sla time slots.

columns.name: USE_ICON_AVAIL_FLAG
columns.description: Property used to indicate whether an icon will be used to identify available time slots.

columns.name: USE_ICON_BOOKED_FLAG
columns.description: Property used to indicate whether an icon will be used to identify booked time slots.

columns.name: USE_ICON_UNAVAIL_FLAG
columns.description: Property used to indicate whether an icon will be used to identify unavailable time slots.

columns.name: USE_ICON_WITHIN_SLA_FLAG
columns.description: Property used to indicate whether an icon will be used to identify within sla time slots.

columns.name: WEEKEND_WARNING_FLAG
columns.description: Property used to indicate whether a warning will be displayed when a weekend time slot is selected.

columns.name: HIGH_QUOTA_CUTOFF
columns.description: Property used to indicate the high quota value.

columns.name: LOW_QUOTA_CUTOFF
columns.description: Property used to indicate the low quota value.

columns.name: CURRENT_DAY_BUFFER
columns.description: Property used to indicate the current day buffer.
